# Runtime deps for the laok stack-arm-001 RoboPay bridge
# Reference platform: ubuntu-22.04, Python 3.11 / 3.12 (see .github/workflows).

# Zenoh's PyPI distribution name is `eclipse-zenoh`; the bare `zenoh` project
# stops at 0.4.0 and is unrelated, so `zenoh>=1.0.0` is unsatisfiable.
# Linux/macOS wheels only -- CI drops this line on Windows runners.
eclipse-zenoh>=1.0.0

# >=2.0.0 is required: `x402.http` (FacilitatorConfig, HTTPFacilitatorClientSync)
# and the snake_case PaymentRequirements fields used by bridge/x402_client.py
# only exist from 2.0.0 onwards. 0.2.x/1.x would import-fail at runtime.
x402>=2.0.0

eth-account>=0.13.0
web3>=7.0.0
httpx>=0.27.0
mujoco>=3.1.0
pybullet==3.2.7
pyyaml>=6.0
pytest>=8.0
